whoAmI.clue: I built a huge boat because God told me a flood was coming.
I used a sling and a stone to defeat a giant named Goliath.
I was thrown into a den of lions, but God kept me safe.
I was swallowed by a big fish after I ran away from God.
God used me to lead His people out of Egypt.
My brothers sold me, but God later made me a leader in Egypt.
I was a queen who bravely spoke up to save my people.
I was a fisherman Jesus called to follow Him. I walked on water for a moment.
I was the mother of Jesus.
I was a little boy who heard God call my name in the night at the temple.
